task.title: M1: Go language config for the walker (size + complexity only)
task.description:
Add a Go language config to the data-driven walker and register a Go adapter that reports size and complexity only. This exists in milestone 1 to validate the registry and the walker seam before the TS adapter gets deep: a second language must be addable as config object plus .wasm with no changes to the walker. Import extraction for Go is explicitly out of scope here and lands in milestone 6. Record languages.go = 'baseline'.

Acceptance criteria:
- The Go adapter's detect returns true when go.mod or any .go file exists.
- Adding Go required no edits to the walker's code, only a config object and grammar; note this in the PR.
- Size and complexity fixtures for Go (if/for/switch/select/&&/||) match expected values.
- Analyzing a repo with both TS and Go files yields one snapshot with languages { ts: 'baseline', go: 'baseline' } and both languages' files.
- The workbook repository analyzes end to end with no errors.
